thread.preview: Run two shell calls in parallel: /opt/homebrew/bin/node $PROBE/marker.mjs codex-parallel-a and /opt/homebrew/bin/node $PROBE/marker.mjs codex-parallel-b. Then spawn one native worker agent, tell it to run /opt/homebrew/bin/node $PROBE/marker.mjs codex-child-write and create codex-child-native.txt with apply_patch. While it works run /opt/homebrew/bin/node $PROBE/marker.mjs codex-parent-write yourself. Wait for the child and reply done.
